response.executive_summary: This assessment reviewed the order notifier from its integration guide and operations notes and approved one finding, described below. The same weakness was documented in both sources; the duplicate conclusion was merged rather than reported twice, and what could not be determined is recorded as a documentation gap.
response.system_overview: The system receives order-status callbacks from the payment provider at a public endpoint and posts updates to the operations channel over HTTPS, as the two supplied documents describe.
response.risk_summary: The approved finding concerns the callback endpoint processing any well-formed request without origin verification — a weakness both documents state affirmatively. Whether re-processing a repeated callback is prevented or harmless is not established and is recorded as a documentation gap.

limitations.text: fnd-001 rests on stated assumptions: No common false positive applies: the integration guide affirmatively states no signature is checked while the provider offers a signing feature — a documented absence, not an unstated mechanism.; No common false positive applies: the incident review affirmatively confirmed unsigned intake, and enabling provider signing is recorded as unscheduled backlog work — a documented absence, not an unstated mechanism.
